profiles.title: Bowel single burst
profiles.notes: Use the timing and spectral distribution for solitary pinch, impact, or bubble-release events.

profiles.title: Bowel multiple burst
profiles.notes: A packeted sequence target; duration and event spacing matter more than a fixed pitch.

profiles.title: Bowel continuous random sound
profiles.notes: Use for dense moving-slurry and irregular wall-contact behavior.

profiles.title: Bowel harmonic sound
profiles.notes: Only five annotated examples; keep the outer range deliberately soft.

profiles.title: Boiling apparatus background
profiles.notes: Do not synthesize this as a noise layer; it describes the source rig before vigorous boiling.

profiles.title: Nucleate boiling
profiles.notes: Use normalized band balance and temporal density, not literal underwater pitch.

profiles.title: Pre-critical boiling
profiles.notes: A compact low-centered regime reference for congested, thick flow.

profiles.title: Transition boiling
profiles.notes: A brighter, unstable regime reference for overlapping rupture and collapse.

profiles.title: Herring fast repetitive ticks
profiles.notes: Underwater swim-bladder/anal-duct acoustics are not a human spectral model. Transfer only irregular pulse spacing, packet duration, and pressure-depletion behavior.

profiles.title: Natural human burp
profiles.notes: Use as a first throat/mouth spectral and temporal anchor; introduce controlled variation rather than overfitting one take.

profiles.title: Diaper-muffled wet human fart
profiles.transfer: direct human reference; infant and diaper filtered
profiles.notes: Useful for a wet low/mid spectral anchor, but not representative of an unobstructed adult fart.

profiles.title: Human tummy rumble sequence
profiles.notes: Treat this as an extended internal-pulse texture, not as a single sustained oscillator.

coverage.growl: The infant tummy-rumble interval is an external body recording, but no isolated controlled wet-fold reference is present.
coverage.burp: One public-domain natural human recording is present; gastric versus supragastric mechanism is not labeled.
coverage.fart: One diaper-muffled infant wet fart supplies a direct anchor; Herring FRT contributes pulse grammar only. Adult and unobstructed tissue-flutter variation remains under-sampled.
coverage.slosh: Bowel CRS and boiling regimes are analogues; neither is an isolated controlled intestinal slosh.
